notes: Focus on user-stated willingness to pay rather than general app discussion

subqueries.label: willingness to pay
subqueries.ranking_query: What apps or app features do users explicitly say they would pay money for?
subqueries.search_query: "would pay for" app OR "pay for an app"

subqueries.label: paid vs free complaints
subqueries.ranking_query: What free app limitations or problems make people willing to pay instead?
subqueries.search_query: app "pay for" OR premium OR subscription (frustrated OR hate OR annoying) free

subqueries.label: productivity tool payments
subqueries.ranking_query: Which productivity or utility apps do users say are worth paying for?
subqueries.search_query: productivity app "would pay" OR "worth paying for"

subqueries.label: app monetization feedback
subqueries.ranking_query: What app pricing models or paid tiers do people actually find reasonable?
subqueries.search_query: app (pricing OR monetization) (good OR fair OR worth) (pay OR paid)
